_note:
Why people come here — a practice's own answer, ticked on claim.

Separate from amenities on purpose. Amenities say what is in the building; these say how the place runs and what it would be like to turn up. Both are self-declared and both are opt-in: an unticked box renders nothing, and no template may read an empty set as a 'no'.

Every option is a fact about the business that the business can verify itself — group size, opening times, whether you need to book. None describes an outcome, a benefit or a feeling. 'Relaxing', 'energising', 'good for stress' and anything naming a condition are deliberately absent: those would be therapeutic claims made on a practitioner's behalf, which this directory does not make anywhere, and they are also the claims a business has the least standing to self-certify.

Step-free access is absent for a different reason, the same one it is absent from amenities: it already exists as an audience tag, where it carries an evidence test rather than a tick.
